pairs.why: Both are almost the same cream-brick door with pink hydrangeas, with the same rendering, light and finish, so neither is clearly closer.
The two are near-duplicates and differ only in small shifts in bush and vine placement, which doesn't make either one closer to the real cards.

A's warm cream wall with dense flowering vines framing the door matches the real door and gate cards, which are full of foliage; B's bare, evenly gridded pink brick reads as flatter and more like a texture.
B has the leafy, flower-framed composition and warm smooth wall of the real cards, while A is an empty, repetitive pink brick surface.
A's thicker vines and flowers framing the top corners come a bit closer to the ivy-wrapped real door; the rendering is otherwise identical.
B's fuller flowering vines framing the door echo the lush real door card slightly better than A's sparser greenery.
B's cream wall with vines and bushes is softer and more lived-in like the real cards; A's bare pink brick reads as a busy tiled texture.
A keeps the foliage framing and the smoother warm wall seen on the real cards, while B is a plain, repetitive pink brick pattern.
